newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rep wants CRP changes in spending bill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rep wants CRP changes in spending bill.

text.p: U.S. House Agriculture Committee Chairman Pat Roberts said Wednesday the House leadership is considering adding conservation reserve program changes to omnibus spending legislation currently under consideration.
Roberts, R.-Kan, said he wanted to give Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman the authority to extend CRP contracts that are due to expire this year.
Roberts has said he is unhappy with changes to CRP rules proposed by Glickman and said he wants to make time to review the proposals.
Negotiations had begun with the Senate on the possibility of adding the amendment to the continuing resolution being discussed by Congress, he said.
Roberts, who is running for the Senate, said the House leadership had decided on former Rep. Bob Smith of Oregon to replace him as House Agriculture Committee chairman.
Smith is standing for election in the seat being vacated by Oregon Republican Wes Cooley.
